name: Evergreen subscription (SaaS, no defined term end) full-period count
expected: An Evergreen line (SellingModelType='Evergreen') routes to V21 step 45 'Evergreen anytime proration filter (Line level)'; Assignment stamps PricingTermCount = EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant (=1, full-period count); excluded from Term-Defined fixed-term proration; with AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false / itemTransientEndDate=null it bills the full evergreen period and the Asset continues past the initial term.
actual: Scenario is NOT testable on real UAT data: FortraUAT has NO priceable Evergreen product. (1) All 4 Evergreen ProductSellingModels (Evergreen-Monthly 0jPWC00000006C92AI, Quarterly 0jPWC00000006CA2AY, Semi-Annual 0jPWC00000006CB2AY, Yearly 0jPWC00000006CC2AY) have Status=Inactive. (2) Zero ProductSellingModelOptions map any product to those PSMs (PSMO totals: TermDefined 4944, OneTime 3939, Evergreen 0). (3) Zero PricebookEntries reference any Evergreen PSM. (4) Zero QuoteLineItems / OrderItems / Assets are SellingModelType='Evergreen' anywhere in the org (QLI SellingModelType distribution across ~1.22M lines: TermDefined 938918, OneTime 226471, None 58451 - Evergreen never appears). No 'Alert Logic MDR' or 'MDR' product exists (test_setup product is illustrative). A real sales rep cannot create an Evergreen line in the UI today (no Evergreen-enabled, priceable product). V21 metadata for this branch IS present and well-formed: constant EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant<value>1</value> with Assignment EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant->PricingTermCount; step 45 'Evergreen anytime proration filter (Line level)' (ListGroup, seq 23) gated on SellingModelType='Evergreen' with criteria pairs {AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false + itemTransientEndDate IsNull} and {AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true + IsNotNull}; SellingModelType IN ('TermDefined','Evergreen') ListOperation confirmed. Branch could not be EXERCISED because no data path reaches it.

V21 metadata: Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition-meta.xml (EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant value=1; step 'Evergreen anytime proration filter (Line level)'; criteria SellingModelType='Evergreen' + AllowPartialProrationPeriods false/true + itemTransientEndDate IsNull/IsNotNull).
proposedFix: Not a V21 fix. To make B-04 testable (and to make Evergreen sellable at all), catalog/config work is required, which is OUT OF VALIDATION SCOPE: (a) set one Evergreen ProductSellingModel Status=Active, (b) create a ProductSellingModelOption linking a Subscription product (e.g. an MSP monthly-recurring SKU) to it, (c) create an active GBP PricebookEntry under the live 'Fortra Price Book' for that (Product, Evergreen SellingModel) pair. Then a Quote line with SellingModelType='Evergreen', AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false, itemTransientEndDate=null can Force-reprice through V21 and the assertion PricingTermCount=1 / full-period bill / no fixed-term proration can be checked. The V21 Evergreen branch metadata itself needs no change.
notes: Anti-phantom-defect doctrine applied: V21's Evergreen branch is present and internally well-formed, but it never ran on valid inputs (no Evergreen line can be created), so no PROCEDURE-DEFECT may be asserted. Preflight FAILS at 'product is priceable as Evergreen': no active Evergreen PSM, no Evergreen PSMO, no Evergreen PBE -> verdict BLOCKED, not FAIL. This is a catalog enablement gap (Evergreen selling model never wired to any product in UAT), distinct from a pricing-tier defect; rootCause recorded N-A(pass) because nothing in V21 is at fault. defect_provenance=none/catalog-derived; no regression ticket. verdict_reason: No priceable Evergreen product exists in FortraUAT (all 4 Evergreen selling models Inactive, 0 Evergreen PSMOs, 0 Evergreen PBEs, 0 Evergreen lines ever), so the V21 Evergreen branch cannot be exercised on real data and preflight fails; the procedure metadata is correct, so this is BLOCKED on a catalog gap, not a defect.
